name: table
description:
table connects Claude to your relationship workspace, so you can find contact context when you need it and save new details back to your personal CRM.

Use the table connector to look up information about people in table, then create or update contacts from explicit details in a conversation, emails, notes, or meeting recap.

_published_faq.name: How do I add table to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add table to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.usetable.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the table MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: table lists 14 MCP tools, including contacts_import_format, contacts_import_prepare_upload, contacts_import_start_upload, contacts_save, delete_group, delete_tag, get_contact, list_contacts, list_groups, list_tags, prepare_contact_avatar_upload, and save_group.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to table?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to table in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
table requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
table is developed by TableAI Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
